stories.description: Implement core logic using timers and AbortController to detect long-running requests (~45s), trigger timeout state, pause UI updates, ensure proper AbortController reuse vs re-init, and guarantee timer cleanup on unmount with continuation and cancellation paths.

stories.title: Render Timeout Modal with Continue/Abandon UX
stories.description: Build and refine modal UI that appears on timeout, providing clear options to continue waiting or abandon the request, including accessibility features (focus trap, keyboard navigation) and explicit UX messaging for long-running uncertainty.

stories.title: Integrate Timeout Handling with Chat Request Flow
stories.description: Integrate timeout logic into end-to-end chat flow ensuring resumed requests continue correctly without duplicate backend calls, cancelled requests clean up state, and UI enforces idempotent handling with no orphaned or duplicated responses.

stories.title: Unit and Interaction Tests for Timeout UX
stories.description: Create tests covering timeout trigger timing, modal display, continue/abandon actions, AbortController behavior, prevention of duplicate responses after resume, and edge cases such as rapid successive timeouts and mid-response user decisions.

stories.title: Define GPTReader and Manifest Schema Contracts

stories.title: Implement GPTReader Reliability and Constraint Enforcement
stories.description: Enhance GPTReader core logic to enforce query limits, handle partial failures, ensure consistent pagination, validate manifest references, and gracefully degrade when limits or data gaps are encountered.

stories.title: Expose Controlled GPTReader Access API

stories.title: Build GPTReader and Manifest Test Suite

stories.title: Integrate GPTReader with Brain Runner and Manifest Enforcement

stories.title: Token Schema and Contract Definition
stories.description: Define bearer token structure including issued_at, expires_at, scope, and issuer fields, and formalize validation contract consistent with existing auth.py behavior.

stories.title: Token Lifecycle Core Logic (Issuance, Rotation, Expiration)
stories.description: Implement token issuance, TTL-based expiration enforcement, and rotation logic (including optional forced rotation) aligned with current validation flow.

stories.description: Implement middleware/service layer enforcing token validation, including signature/format checks, scope validation, and strict expiration (TTL + issued_at). Reject malformed or expired tokens.

stories.description: Integrate token validation middleware into GPTReader and Azure Function pipeline endpoints to enforce authentication consistently across protected services.

stories.title: Token Lifecycle Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests covering issuance, expiration, rotation behavior, and validation failures, including protected endpoint enforcement via GPTReader.

stories.title: Lock Schema with TTL and Ownership Metadata
stories.description: Define the lock data model including lock_id, owner_id, acquired_at, ttl_seconds, expiration_timestamp, and status to support TTL enforcement and recovery decisions.

stories.title: TTL Enforcement and Expired Lock Cleanup Logic
stories.description: Implement logic to automatically detect expired locks based on TTL and safely release or mark them recoverable without corrupting in-flight executions.

stories.title: Deadlock Detection and Recovery Mechanism
stories.description: Implement detection of circular or stalled lock states and provide recovery actions including forced unlock, retry eligibility, and safe reassignment of ownership.

stories.title: Brain Runner Integration and Internal Lock Management API
stories.description: Integrate TTL enforcement and deadlock recovery into brain_runner and brain_loop execution flow and expose internal lock management interfaces (acquire, renew, release, force-unlock) with structured logging for observability.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Lock TTL and Deadlock Recovery
stories.description: Create tests covering TTL expiration, concurrent lock contention, deadlock scenarios, and recovery correctness to ensure system stability under failure conditions.

stories.title: Audit Log Schema and Contract Definition
stories.description: Define immutable audit log schema strictly aligned to existing debug_logger fields (chat_id, session_id, tool_name, token_usage, error_flag, timestamps) and extend minimally with hash_chain fields; enforce compatibility with current MongoDB document structure without introducing a new audit system.

stories.title: Append-Only Write Enforcement Logic
stories.description: Implement append-only enforcement as a wrapper around debug_logger such that only insert operations are permitted; add per-session hash chaining for tamper evidence while preserving existing Mongo insert patterns and avoiding any new storage abstraction.

stories.title: Audit Log Read API (Controlled Access)
stories.description: Expose a read-only internal FastAPI endpoint within FindCare backend for audit inspection (dev/admin only), reusing main.py routing and ensuring no external or Brain-level audit access is introduced.

stories.title: System-Wide Audit Logging Integration (FindCare Scope)
stories.description: Instrument FindCare backend components only (tool_router, safety_service, and existing debug_logger call sites) to capture tool execution, safety triggers, and errors with de-identified payloads; explicitly exclude Brain or cross-application audit instrumentation.

stories.title: Audit Logging Test Suite and Tamper Detection Validation
stories.description: Extend test_debug_logger.py to validate append-only guarantees, hash chain integrity, and mutation attempt rejection within the FindCare backend context only; simulate tampering and ensure detection without introducing cross-system dependencies.

stories.title: Audit Event Schema and Contract Extension
stories.description: Define and standardize audit event schema including actor, action, timestamp, tool_call metadata, request/response hashes, and correlation IDs, extending existing debug_logger structure for immutability readiness.

stories.title: Append-Only Write Pipeline Implementation
stories.description: Implement backend write pipeline enforcing append-only behavior (no updates/deletes), including sequential write guarantees and hash linkage between records for tamper evidence.

stories.title: Audit Logging Integration with Tool Router and Services
stories.description: Integrate audit logging into tool_router and domain services to capture all system actions and tool calls, including inputs, outputs, and execution metadata without impacting existing flows.

stories.title: Audit Log Integrity and Tamper Detection Tests
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating append-only guarantees, hash chain integrity, and detection of any tampering or mutation attempts in stored audit records.

stories.title: Internal Audit Query Interface
stories.description: Implement internal-only query utilities for retrieving audit records by correlation_id, actor, and time range, including verification of hash chain integrity during read operations without exposing public API endpoints.

stories.title: Audit Log Storage Structure and Indexing
stories.description: Define MongoDB collection structure, indexing strategy (timestamp, correlation_id, actor), and write patterns to support efficient append-only storage and retrieval aligned with debug_logger persistence.

stories.title: De-identification and Sensitive Data Handling in Audit Logs
stories.description: Extend audit logging to enforce de-identification rules and sensitive data filtering consistent with existing debug_logger behavior, ensuring no PHI leakage while preserving forensic usefulness.

stories.title: Tool Router and Debug Logger Integration for Audit Events
stories.description: Integrate audit logging into tool_router and debug_logger so that every tool invocation, input validation, and result is captured as an audit event with correlation_id propagation across the request lifecycle.

stories.title: FastAPI Middleware for End-to-End Audit Capture
stories.description: Implement FastAPI middleware in main.py to automatically log request start, response completion, errors, and latency as audit events, ensuring full lifecycle traceability for every API interaction.

stories.title: Audit Logging Performance and Throughput Validation
stories.description: Design and execute performance tests to validate that append-only audit logging does not exceed acceptable latency thresholds under concurrent load, including batching and write efficiency validation.

stories.title: Migration and Backfill of Existing Debug Logs into Audit Format
stories.description: Implement a one-time migration utility to transform existing debug_logger records into the new append-only audit log schema, ensuring continuity of historical traceability without violating immutability constraints.

stories.title: Audit Log Hash Chain Integrity Implementation
stories.description: Implement hash chaining across audit log entries so each record includes a hash of the previous record, enabling tamper-evident verification of append-only integrity.

stories.title: Audit Log Write Pipeline Optimization (Batching and Async)
stories.description: Enhance audit logging with asynchronous and batched write capabilities to MongoDB to reduce latency impact on request handling while preserving strict append-only guarantees.

stories.title: Audit Log Query and Filtering Interface (Internal)
stories.description: Implement internal query utilities for audit logs supporting filtering by correlation_id, tool_name, event_type, and time range to enable debugging, QA, and operational analysis without violating immutability.

stories.title: Audit Log Access Control and Redaction Enforcement
stories.description: Implement access control rules and automatic redaction for sensitive fields (e.g., PHI) when audit logs are read, ensuring compliance with HIPAA Safe Harbor and existing de-identification patterns.

stories.description: Build core logic to handle transient disk failures with configurable retries, exponential backoff, and fallback strategies (e.g., alternate temp storage or safe abort with recovery state).

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Local Disk Resilience
stories.description: Create tests simulating disk failures (e.g., permission errors, unavailable paths, partial writes) to validate retry behavior, fallback execution, and data integrity after recovery.

stories.title: Define Manifest Snapshot Freshness Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define metadata schema for manifest snapshots including timestamp, source hash, generation version, and freshness TTL policy used to determine validity before execution.

stories.description: Build logic to evaluate whether a manifest snapshot is fresh based on TTL, file hash drift, and last generation timestamp; return pass/fail with reason.

stories.description: Provide an internal API or callable interface that returns current manifest freshness status and triggers regeneration requirement if stale.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Manifest Freshness
stories.description: Create tests covering TTL expiry, hash mismatch, valid snapshot pass, and stale snapshot detection across manifest generation and read workflows.

stories.title: Integrate Freshness Check into Execution Pipeline
stories.description: Integrate freshness validation into dev_pipeline and brain_runner execution paths to ensure stale manifests trigger regeneration before use.

stories.title: Health Check Logging and Observability Integration
stories.description: Integrate health endpoint execution with debug logging to capture invocation metrics and dependency status outcomes without exposing sensitive information, supporting operational monitoring and troubleshooting.
